title: Operate the line. Read its people.
summary: A prebuilt conveyor is a physical operating puzzle: regulate flow, choose whose judgment shapes the room, and see individual agents turn those decisions into work and consequences.
status: Prebuilt first-turn line implemented. BDI agents, polished character acting, shared policies and later-room progression remain proposed.
direction: Owner direction: remove all player building. Keep the room topology and cinematic factory. Workers and supervisors are BDI agents; LLM use is optional. Supervisors influence capability, interpretation, decisions and other agents.
recommendation: Start at the console, receive the mandate and choose an adviser. Compare the same inherited line under LIMEN and STILETTO. Prove a readable gate inspection, a physical cradle transfer and an actual worker response before expanding the factory repertoire.
fun: A queue shrinks because of a change I made. The limiting step moves somewhere else, giving me a new problem I can actually see.
This is my kind of factory
Orderly and protective, aggressive and productive, or loyal to a favourite supervisor. The same inherited equipment supports different operating choices and leaves different costs and people behind.
I can hold the feed, change pace or authorize a response because I recognize a developing situation. Successful restraint can be as satisfying as a record batch.
A stable operating approach and a trusted supervisor free attention for another room. Delegation grows from capability and relationships.
chain: Clearance affects when particular workers reach the floor and how reliably they take assigned posts. Faster entry is useful; incorrect deployment can leave an expensive station waiting.
Accept brain workpieces into a finite buffer. A feed hold stops adding work without erasing what is already on the belt. Do not add a raw-material currency yet.
Machines and workers process individual batches. A faster intake cannot compensate for an assembly station that is occupied, unattended or blocked.

Finish and validate output against the same production contract. The art establishes brain handling; the final brain-to-robot activation step needs a specific visual treatment, not an assumed existing asset.
Rejected work goes to the existing melting route. Brewery recovery becomes available later. Creating extra waste must not be a universally profitable shortcut.
Permanently commit completed robots to the weekly quota or retain them. Retained workers join next shift; sending output away does not secretly add it to the factory's population.

layouts.name: 01 · Compact line
layouts.tag: Author layout reference · Save space. Accept exposure.
layouts.gain: Short worker trips and a compact service area in a prebuilt layout.
layouts.cost: A shared crossing between workers and the moving line couples hurried movement to hazard exposure. One blockage can obstruct several jobs.
layouts.see: Workers wait at the crossing under orderly operation; under pressure some cross between loads. A small hesitation can be harmless until traffic grows.
layouts.response: Meter intake or use protective operating rules. A safer path is an authored layout alternative, not something the player builds.
layouts.supervisor: LIMEN enforces clearance and pacing. STILETTO can exploit the short route, with more missed checks and disordered arrivals.
layouts.carry: These are authored scenario comparisons, not player construction options. Physical routes shape exposure and later social consequences.

layouts.name: 02 · Protected aisle
layouts.tag: Author layout reference · Spend room to protect flow.
layouts.gain: A dedicated worker route avoids the main belt crossing and makes blocked access easy to diagnose. It is easier to operate predictably.
layouts.cost: The authored protected aisle trades crossing exposure for longer walking and transit.
layouts.see: Workers use the aisle; stations wait if the longer trip matters. Material queues remain visible even when nobody is in immediate danger.
layouts.response: Read which station is waiting; change feed, effort or delegation rather than reconstructing the room.
layouts.supervisor: LIMEN benefits from an arrangement that makes compliance practical. STILETTO may dislike its pace, but cannot walk through a physical guard.
layouts.carry: These are authored scenario comparisons, not player construction options. Physical routes shape exposure and later social consequences.

layouts.name: 03 · Parallel assembly
layouts.tag: Author layout reference · More capacity. More coordination.
layouts.gain: A prebuilt parallel line can increase capacity if both cells have workers and clearance.
layouts.cost: More joins and crossings need coordination. Outtake can become the bottleneck; empty stations cannot invent workers.
layouts.see: Loads alternate between cells, then bunch at the merge. Workers yield at the service crossing; a worker at the wrong post creates a visibly uneven line rather than a hidden global penalty.
layouts.response: Hold intake, change the operating arrangement or reconsider the supervisor. A buffer buys time; it cannot cure insufficient sustained clearance.
layouts.supervisor: STILETTO can push a well-supported expansion. LIMEN can make merge discipline reliable. Neither grants missing machinery or invents workers.
layouts.carry: These are authored scenario comparisons, not player construction options. Physical routes shape exposure and later social consequences.

sections.title: Prebuilt spatial authority
sections.intro: Approved room proportions and connections stay. Security and the Lattice Forge are open first; later rooms remain locked. Empty layout plots are author composition/traffic space, not a player placement interface.
rows: World
Nine zones fill a continuous building at a common 15 m hall height. Keep the direct Security–Theatre connection and process pipe walls.
Scale
Maintain room scale while framing one work area clearly. Workers must read as bodies operating real machinery, not dots in an empty hall.
Author tooling
The separate factory-floor route can inspect equipment and floor plans. Author calibration is not a gameplay purchase or unlock.

sections.title: The operating loop
sections.intro: Observe a constraint, choose a useful control, see its physical result and reconsider. Not a click per brain.
rows: Input
Open, meter or close intake. Existing work continues when new input is closed.
Effort
Steady or pushed drive changes useful work and wear. Full outtake stops assembly.
Delegation
LIMEN and STILETTO change capacity, clearance and authority. A chosen adviser acts automatically in their assigned room.
Outcome
Dispatch permanently sends produced agents toward quota or retains them. Payment, condition and surviving people carry forward.

sections.title: The agent interaction loop
sections.intro: BDI powers intention. A shared action contract links movement, work, social influence and observed consequence.
rows: Perceive
The agent receives local observations and attributed information, not omniscience.
Commit
A deterministic plan reserves a route, workstation and any partner. Intentions persist until complete, invalidated or interrupted.
Act
A worker approaches, waits, handles a cradle and clears the station. A supervisor can inspect, hurry, calm or reprimand a particular recipient.
Remember
Actual effects update state and causal history. Private traces explain the path; public views reveal only permitted evidence.
Animation
A clip represents an accepted action. Contact sound and visual phase do not decide production, injury or trust.

sections.title: Policies and progression
sections.intro: Room operating policy and later facility access remain design levers. Free placement and construction do not.
rows: Shared policy catalog
Apply relevant policies per room; their exact cost, reversibility and implementation remain open.
Specialists
Witch introduces engineering; Thrum introduces relief with productivity/discipline costs. No repair tool in parts 01–02.
Cash
Construction removal leaves no immediate first-day cash sink. Longer-run funding, payroll and repair require a separate economy pass. Do not replace removed building with an undisclosed fee.
Unlocks
Existing Theatre, Brewery, Weaving and Cortex become accessible through world readiness and funding, not a hidden turn counter. These are future progression, not delivered by the first-day slice.

sections.title: One console, focused actions
sections.intro: The world stays continuous while interfaces change jobs.
rows: Entry
Morning console → leadership call → adviser and assignments. The inherited line is already equipped.
Room
One selected room, three authored CCTV angles; one angle on phones. Focused operating controls preserve room context.
Time
Eighteen-hour shift and six-hour charge, represented by fixed simulation ticks and short phase cards. No build mode at night.
Agency
Assignments, direct flow controls, consequential responses and permanent allocation. No compulsory busywork when the line is healthy.

sections.title: Next production proof
sections.intro: Make the people convincing before multiplying the room puzzles.
rows: Art
One worker family plus LIMEN and STILETTO, matching original silhouettes and material language.
Motion
Gate inspection, cradle transfer and one supervisor–worker exchange with correct contacts and readable response.
Performance
Compare 10, 24 and 100 agents; one and three camera passes; loading, CPU/GPU work and memory. Offscreen simulation persists.
Boundary
The present game has individual worker records and bounded task motion. General BDI, production rigs and synchronized paired animation are not implemented.

research.lesson: Cliff Harris describes an optimization game whose bottleneck changes as the product and process change. The value is in finding a better arrangement and investing for future gains.
research.map: Moving constraints, visibly installed specialist machines and capital competing with expansion.
research.limit: Do not import its entire car-part economy. Loopforge needs people and authority to alter the same line, not merely a larger optimization spreadsheet.

research.lesson: In FFF-129, the developers describe recurring upkeep as a source of stagnation and discuss shifting effort toward more lasting construction. FFF-405 shows instrumentation and logistics controls being redesigned around readable factory context.
research.map: A solved room should stay solved long enough to enjoy and delegate it. Instruments belong beside the visible process they explain.
research.limit: These are dated design accounts, not proof that Factorio's full scale or logistics depth fits a one-minute Loopforge day.

research.lesson: Zachtronics frames the game as designing, running and optimizing factories in three dimensions, with performance comparisons after a solution works.
research.map: Separate making the chain function from making it better. Let geometry, workers and actual flow explain the difference between two layouts.
research.limit: Do not make a perfect single solution or score histogram the purpose of Loopforge. Different social and operating outcomes should remain valuable.

research.lesson: The Rainpunk redesign replaced a broadly passive production burden with greater control over when to take power and its associated blight exposure.
research.map: Let the player choose to push a capable line and see why the added exposure exists. Risk should buy a real benefit rather than tax every action equally.
research.limit: Its fuel and blight systems do not map literally. Use existing wear, worker stress and hazardous tasks before inventing another resource.

research.lesson: The designers describe the Book of Laws evolving toward player-initiated decisions, with small commitments accumulating into a changed society.
research.map: Room policies should express leadership and leave a remembered history. Hardware and policy are complementary ways to change work.
research.limit: A room rule is not automatically a city law. Avoid a forced morality ladder where each efficient choice must be cruel or every reversal instantly resets behaviour.

research.lesson: The official description connects six unlockable sectors, population trust, infrastructure development and emergencies within one station.
research.map: Use a shared factory with distinct room jobs and persistent local operating rules. The owner’s Loopforge direction is a reusable policy catalog applied per room.
research.limit: This source does not establish an exact policy implementation to copy. Loopforge policy effects must be defined against its own tasks and workers, not inferred from an IXION theme.

research.lesson: Peter Curry describes showing network health at a glance and treating audio as information. The developer also discusses deterministic simulation for reproducible behaviour and debugging.
research.map: Queues, empty stations and work rhythms communicate the constraint before a diagnostic panel. Deterministic traces let us connect the visible problem to a cause.
research.limit: Readable traffic alone is insufficient: Loopforge workers have capabilities, private states and reasons to depart from a plan.

research.lesson: Phil Duncan explains how level geometry, handovers and constrained routes generate cooperation and disrupt static role assignments.
research.map: Walking and crossings can make spatial arrangements meaningful even with a short production recipe.
research.limit: Do not inherit its demand for constant coordinated manual handling. Five rooms of frantic task switching would fight Loopforge's adviser, policy and delegation loop.

research.lesson: Cook distinguishes repeated learning through action and feedback from an authored progression of experiences. A loop depends on what the player learns and can do next, not simply a repeated sequence of screens.
research.map: Specify the expectation, action, visible response and next decision for build, operation, delegation and output allocation. Use the guided Security sequence to teach actions that later acquire meaningful alternatives.
research.limit: Calling the day a loop does not prove it is interesting. A solved arrangement may stay solved; introduce new demands through the actual factory and its people, not a compulsory daily emergency.

research.game: Factorio: teach a construction verb once
research.lesson: The developers describe ordering tutorials around prerequisite concepts. The ordinary build ghost gives a player a visible placement preview before committing.
research.map: Historical interface reference only. The Loopforge construction mechanic has been removed.
research.limit: Do not reintroduce a placement tutorial or builder through this reference.

research.lesson: The build gun is an explicit tool state, and onboarding introduces concrete construction objectives. The community-maintained official wiki documents the flow.
research.map: Historical interface reference only. The Loopforge construction mechanic has been removed.
research.limit: Do not reintroduce a placement tutorial or builder through this reference.

researchBoundary: Historical competitor study. Keep lessons about visible flow, feedback and meaningful intervention. Construction examples below are references to other games, not current Loopforge features; the owner removed all player building on 12 October.
